diagram_previews.alt: Two cones on a common vertical axis drawn in side view: the black cone has its base ellipse around O1 at the bottom (radius r1) and apex at O2; the blue cone has its base ellipse around O2 at the top (radius r2) and apex at O1. Their surfaces cross along a red ellipse (circle seen obliquely) of radius r between the two bases.
